profile_candidate.scope: Offline OAuth resource/scopes, credential lifecycle and audit regressions; no live identity or deployment attestation.

access-boundary.claim: Access tokens stay audience-bound and tools enforce declared scopes.

data-exposure.claim: Credential and token errors do not expose secrets; audit output stays bounded.

untrusted-instructions.claim: Text from a caller cannot add a tool scope or authorize incoming-token forwarding.

consequential-actions.claim: An unavailable refresh fails closed and stops the stdio child.

evidence-lineage.claim: Audit changes are detected relative to a separately trusted terminal checkpoint.

bounded-claims.claim: Publication excludes local assurance state and does not imply live lab or physical-passkey validation.

access-boundary.limitations: Source inspection only; a passing job is not proof of every claim.

data-exposure.limitations: Source inspection only; a passing job is not proof of every claim.

untrusted-instructions.limitations: Source inspection only; a passing job is not proof of every claim.

consequential-actions.limitations: Source inspection only; a passing job is not proof of every claim.

evidence-lineage.limitations: Source inspection only; a passing job is not proof of every claim.

bounded-claims.limitations: Source inspection only; a passing job is not proof of every claim.

remaining_gaps: CI has no live shared Kubernetes or physical-passkey proof. Semantic prompt injection and continuous human-session revocation need separate evaluations.
